title: Settings
footer: ←/→ Tab section · ↑/↓ row · Enter edit/open · Space toggle · r reset · Esc close

tool:fileExtras.label: File extras (hash/diff/search)
tool:fileExtras.description: Hashing, structured diff, and in-file search helpers.

tool:coreFiles.label: Core file tools
tool:coreFiles.description: Read / write / edit files (the workhorse file tools).

tool:coreFilesOnAnthropic.label: Core files on Anthropic
tool:coreFilesOnAnthropic.description: Also expose the core file tools on the Anthropic channel.

tool:git.label: Git tools
tool:git.description: Status / diff / log / add / commit helpers.

tool:process.label: Process tools
tool:process.description: Start, inspect, and kill background processes.

tool:shellAdvanced.label: Advanced shell
tool:shellAdvanced.description: Extra shell primitives beyond a single bash call.

tool:codeGraph.label: Code graph
tool:codeGraph.description: Symbol graph queries: definitions, callers, callees, blast radius.

tool:astGrep.label: AST search & rewrite
tool:astGrep.description: Structural search and rewrite over the syntax tree.

tool:dependencyResearch.label: Dependency source
tool:dependencyResearch.description: Clone a dependency's repository so the agent can read library internals.

tool:webclone.label: Web page snapshot
tool:webclone.description: Snapshot a live page with its assets into a self-contained bundle.

model.label: Model
model.description: The model id used for your turns (opens the model picker).

mode.label: Permission mode
mode.description: How tool calls are approved (default / acceptEdits / plan / bypass / …).

thinking.label: Thinking level
thinking.description: Reasoning effort forwarded to the model (off → max; ultracode also enables workflow tools).

subagentModels.label: Subagent models…
subagentModels.description: Assign a provider/model to each dispatchable subagent.

theme.label: Theme
theme.description: TUI colour theme (built-ins, or reuse your Claude Code / Codex palette).

custom-theme.label: Custom theme colours…
custom-theme.description: Author a custom palette on top of a base theme.

output-style.label: Output style
output-style.description: Response style appended to the system prompt (concise / explanatory / learning).

status-theme.label: Status bar colours
status-theme.description: Status-bar colour palette (default / dim / vivid / mono).

status-segments.label: Status bar segments…
status-segments.description: Which segments the footer shows, and their order.

mascot-enabled.label: Mascot
mascot-enabled.description: Show the terminal mascot above the footer.

mascot-style.label: Mascot style
mascot-style.description: Which mascot creature is shown (clawd / cat / robot).

highlight.label: Syntax-highlight output
highlight.description: Syntax-highlight inline tool/file output (Bash / PS / file reads).

lineNumbers.label: File line numbers
lineNumbers.description: Show 1-based line numbers in file/code result views.

verboseDefault.label: Start in detail (expand-all) mode
verboseDefault.description: Begin each session with every cell expanded.

streamReveal.label: Typewriter reveal
streamReveal.description: Reveal streamed text at a gentle typing cadence (interactive TTY only).

clickToExpand.label: Click a cell to expand it
clickToExpand.description: Fullscreen only: a mouse click toggles just that cell (disables burst-folding).

notify.label: Ring the bell when a turn finishes
notify.description: Ring the terminal bell after a long turn so you can tab away.

desktopNotifications.label: Desktop notifications
desktopNotifications.description: Also fire an OS desktop notification on completion (only when the bell is on).

maxLines.label: Inline result line cap
maxLines.description: Max lines of an expanded inline result before the tail is summarised.

pagerThreshold.label: Pager threshold (lines)
pagerThreshold.description: Above this many lines, show a preview + pager hint instead of the whole body.

webTools.label: Web tools (search/fetch)
webTools.description: Expose web_search / web_fetch to the agent.

skillTool.label: Skill tool
skillTool.description: Let the agent load a skill's instructions on demand via the Skill tool.

skillLoadMode.label: Skill loading
skillLoadMode.description: How skills enter the prompt — a name-only catalog vs every full body.

slashCommandTool.label: SlashCommand tool
slashCommandTool.description: Let the agent run a slash command via the SlashCommand tool.

externalSkills.label: Reuse external skill dirs
externalSkills.description: Also discover Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode skill directories.

pluginTools.label: Plugin tools (dynamic workflow)
pluginTools.description: Expose the in-tree first-party plugin tools (web-tools, workflow, …) to the agent.

autoRoute.label: Auto tier routing (headless run)
autoRoute.description: One-shot/headless run only: route each prompt to the cheapest capable tier.

showActiveSkills.label: Announce active skills each turn
showActiveSkills.description: Print an 'Active skills (N): …' notice whenever a turn loads enabled skills.

skillDirs.label: Extra skill dirs…
skillDirs.description: Extra directories to discover SKILL.md skills from.

allowedTools.label: Allowed tools allowlist…
allowedTools.description: Restrict the agent to an allow-list of tools (empty = all tools allowed).

gitProtectedBranches.label: Protected branches…
gitProtectedBranches.description: Branches /commit refuses to commit to directly (space-separated).

gitBaseBranch.label: PR base branch…
gitBaseBranch.description: Base branch /pr targets. Empty = auto-detect main → master.

gitCoauthorTrailer.label: Commit co-author trailer
gitCoauthorTrailer.description: Append the Co-Authored-By trailer to /commit messages (custom text: config.json git.coauthorTrailer).

gitPrFooter.label: PR body footer
gitPrFooter.description: Append the Claude Code footer to /pr bodies (custom text: config.json git.prFooter).

systemPrompt.label: System prompt…
systemPrompt.description: Extra system-prompt text prepended to every turn.

layout.label: Layout
layout.description: Fullscreen (pinned banner/composer) vs native terminal scrollback.

mouse.label: Mouse model
mouse.description: Wheel-scroll the transcript vs native click-drag text selection (fullscreen).

selection.label: Drag to select
selection.description: In-app text selection over the rendered frame; auto-copy puts it on the clipboard on release.

vim.label: Vim editing mode
vim.description: Modal NORMAL/INSERT editing in the composer (also /vim).

terminalTitle.label: Dynamic terminal title
terminalTitle.description: Update the terminal window/tab title with live session state.

clipboardMode.label: Clipboard OSC 52 mode
clipboardMode.description: Copy strategy: auto (OSC 52 over SSH) / always (force OSC 52) / never.

clipboardMaxBytes.label: Clipboard OSC 52 byte cap
clipboardMaxBytes.description: Max bytes for an OSC 52 copy (0 = no cap; terminals silently drop huge ones).

editor.label: External editor
editor.description: Preferred editor for /open and clickable file paths (blank = auto-detect).

loggingFileLevel.label: File log level
loggingFileLevel.description: Minimum severity persisted to ~/.cognia/logs/mcp.log (the /mcp logs panel always shows everything).

loggingMcpLogMaxKb.label: MCP log rotation size (KiB)
loggingMcpLogMaxKb.description: mcp.log rotates to mcp.log.1 once it exceeds this size.

loggingCrashLogMaxKb.label: Crash log rotation size (KiB)
loggingCrashLogMaxKb.description: crash.log rotates to crash.log.1 once it exceeds this size (0 = never).

loggingViewMcpLogs.label: View MCP / sidecar logs…
loggingViewMcpLogs.description: Open the in-TUI log panel over the live MCP / sidecar event stream.

loggingLogDir.label: Log directory
loggingLogDir.description: Where crash.log and mcp.log live on disk.

autoCompact.label: Auto-compact context
autoCompact.description: Automatically compact the live context as it nears the model's window.

autoCompactThreshold.label: Auto-compact threshold
autoCompactThreshold.description: Fraction of the context window that triggers auto-compaction (clamped 0.5–0.98).

streamIdleTimeoutMs.label: Stream idle timeout (ms)
streamIdleTimeoutMs.description: Abort a turn if the model stream stalls this long mid-turn (0 = disabled).

aiSdkMaxSteps.label: Agent step budget (non-Anthropic)
aiSdkMaxSteps.description: Max agentic tool-call legs per turn on OpenAI-compatible providers (runaway backstop).

toolExecutionTimeoutMs.label: Read-only tool timeout (ms)
toolExecutionTimeoutMs.description: Per-tool deadline for read-only tools on non-Anthropic providers (0 = disabled).

subagentStreamIdleTimeoutMs.label: Subagent stream idle timeout (ms)
subagentStreamIdleTimeoutMs.description: Stream-idle timeout for a dispatched subagent turn — far higher than interactive (0 = off).

subagentMaxDepth.label: Subagent max nesting depth
subagentMaxDepth.description: How deep dispatch_agent may nest (subagents spawning subagents). 1 = subagents are leaves.

subagentMaxConcurrent.label: Subagent max concurrency
subagentMaxConcurrent.description: How many subagents one dispatch_agent fan-out may run at once over the live sidecar. 1 = one after another.

cwd.label: Working directory…
cwd.description: Choose a directory. Switching recreates the agent context; the visible transcript remains.

additionalRoots.label: Additional roots…
additionalRoots.description: Browse to add a root. Actual access depends on the external agent and its permissions.

customLimits.label: Custom limits sources
customLimits.description: User-defined usage/limits sources surfaced in /limits (edit in config.json).

hook:auto-context-loader.description: Inject .cognia/agent-context.md as standing context at session start.

hook:auto-context-loader-prompt.description: Inject .cognia/agent-context.md as standing context on every prompt.

hook:cost-quota-guard.description: Deny a turn once the session token budget is exceeded.

hook:pii-safety-guard.description: Block a prompt that carries obvious PII / credentials.

hook:pii-safety-guard-tool.description: Block a tool call whose input carries obvious PII / credentials.

hooksPanel.label: Hooks…
hooksPanel.description: Browse hook sources, inspect details, edit and reload configuration.

providerDescription: Which AI provider serves this session (opens the provider picker).
providerDescriptionExternal: Saved provider for the built-in backend; changing it leaves the active external agent unchanged.
credentialDescription: Set or replace the active provider's API key or subscription token.
credentialDescriptionExternal: Set or replace the saved built-in provider's API key or subscription token.
keyDescription: Current binding — change it from Rebind a key… below.
footerCompact: ←→ Tab section · Enter edit · Esc close
editFooter: Editing · ←/→ value · Enter save · Esc cancel · Tab section
workspaceBusy: Finish or stop the current response before switching directories.
workspaceChanged: Working directory: {path}. Agent context will restart on the next message; the visible transcript is retained.
removeRootDescription: Remove this additional root from the session configuration.
workspaceRootsMemory: Could not save additional directories. This change is active only for this CLI session.
